name: native-ci-admission
goal: Expose admission timeouts so native CI can identify and resolve its blocking condition

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Hosted native jobs time out without a waiting reason. A critical-pressure fixture reproduced a generic timeout while onWaiting reported the cause; hosted cause remains unknown.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: test/services/resource-queue.test.ts covers pressure and cancellation but never expires that waiter or asserts its error. Extend its existing lifecycle to verify timeout detail and lease cleanup.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed 37cfeb9c; the unchanged standard resource queue test failed twice because timeout messages omitted the reservation and pressure reasons. Harness red record 2dfad99b retained the run.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Timeouts retain the last admission reason, host capacity, requested resources and root reservations; resource policy is unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: At d8bdf3b4, unchanged queue scenarios passed with paired red record b473674d and green record b09fb9c3 in the same environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
